purpose: Cover every remaining red/green-adjacent gray cell while reusing five audited Phase S1 measurement shards and adding fresh shots at only the one uncovered cell.

analysis.primary: Bayesian posterior OLS linear-projection slope against code distance
analysis.prior_sensitivity: Jeffreys Beta(1/2,1/2) primary and uniform Beta(1,1) sensitivity
analysis.seed_reuse_pooling: Pool audited Phase S1 independent L7/L9/L11 counts with the Phase 2 base counts.
analysis.distance_reuse_pooling: Use Phase 2 L7/L9/L11, pool the independent Phase S1 L11 anchor into L11, and add its L13 counts, yielding L7/L9/L11/L13.
analysis.new_job_pooling: Pool the new independent L7/L9/L11 counts at q=0.55,p=0.24 with the Phase 2 base counts.
analysis.claim_boundary: Update only the six current red/green-adjacent gray cells; no other gray cell, interpolation, or asymptotic boundary claim.

preflight_gate: Implement and test a one-job non-overwriting dispatcher, reuse-hash/source audit, new-output completion audit, and heterogeneous pooled analyzer before launch.
stop_rule: Stop after one new job and 3000 decodes. Do not rerun the five Phase S1 cells, add another gray cell, add p/q midpoints, or expand to square.
